name: negative_zero_lloq
why: SX4 additive a = 1.0, negative = zero with LLOQ 0.8, 20 replicates (zeroed values are below the limit: cens = 1)
note: z_eta and z_eps are the hexadecimal doubles of the reference transform; the engine's own z match them to tol_z (exactly in the central region); eta, p, pred, ipred, sigma, y_raw, y, dv are decimals of the 256-bit result from those z, compared with max(|expected|, scale) and tol_exact; y_scale is |ipred| + sigma |z_eps|; cens and counts are exact; the summary is the type 7 quantile of the double rounding of y, ipred over replicates (tolerance)
